description:
DeFi from DeFiLlama: compare one or two protocols on TVL and fees, or find the best yields with a minimum TVL, a chain and a stablecoin filter, each with its own source. Example: {"protocols":["aave","compound"]} or {"stablecoin_only":true,"chain":"Ethereum"}.

Costs 2 credits; each optional metrics entry (stablecoins) adds 1. Every section carries its own source receipt (provider, fetched_at, runtime_status); a section that fails is listed under missing and never guessed.

chain.description: Filter yields to one chain (DeFiLlama name, for example "Ethereum", "Arbitrum", "Solana"); also the chain for stablecoins. Default all chains, and Ethereum for stablecoins.

metrics.description: Default: tvl and fees for protocols, yields otherwise. Optional: stablecoins (supply on the chain).

min_tvl_usd.description: Yields: minimum pool TVL in USD. Default 1,000,000, which filters out most traps.

protocols.description: One or two DeFiLlama protocol slugs to compare, for example ["aave","compound"]. Omit for a yield search.

response_format.description: Output format: 'json' for structured data (default) or 'markdown' for human-readable text.

name: defi_yields
title: DeFi Yields
